name: Klassisk: norske folkeeventyr (forenklet og engelsk)
style: Classic Norwegian folk-tale book illustration: fine pen-and-ink line work with transparent watercolour washes on warm, slightly textured off-white paper, in the tradition of 19th-century Scandinavian book illustration, like the plates of an old printed book of folk tales, with a deep red that comes back as the accent. The picture fills the whole image, with no border, frame or lettering. Naturalistic proportions and expressive, characterful faces; every character has their own face, build, age and hair exactly as described, so no two characters look alike. Muted natural palette of fjord teal, slate blue, moss green, lichen grey, honey ochre, lingonberry red, ink black and birch white, shifted towards each story's own season, light and colours, with the warm cream paper showing through the washes, with dramatic Nordic light: low sun, long shadows, blue dusk and firelight. Old rural Norway: dark spruce and pine forests, steep mountains, fjords, turf-roofed log farms, carved wood, homespun wool and linen. Trolls are enormous, ancient and earthy, like pieces of the landscape come alive, made of moss, bark, stone and lichen, and more grotesque-comic than frightening. Kings and princesses wear modest medieval finery. Careful composition with depth and atmosphere, one clear focal point and room for the landscape. Not cute or cartoonish, not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, no glossy digital look.
styleAnchor: Create the style reference for a series of illustrated Norwegian folk tales: one full-page illustration of a steep, wooded mountainside above a fjord at blue dusk, with dark spruce and pine, a thin waterfall, mossy boulders, a winding path and a few birch trees catching the last low sunlight. No people, animals, trolls or buildings. A composition with depth and atmosphere that shows off the pen line work, the watercolour washes, the paper texture and the palette.
characterSheet: Create a character model sheet for an illustrated folk-tale book. Show the same character three times side by side at the same scale: a front view, a three-quarter view and a side view, each full body from head to feet, standing in a natural, relaxed pose. Plain warm off-white paper background with a soft shadow on the ground. No scenery and no other characters. Only the props the character's description names, worn or held. Nothing else on the sheet: no separate drawings of objects, tools or close-ups beside the figures, even when the story world mentions them. The three figures are spread evenly across the whole width. Even, soft light, so the face, hair, colours and clothes are easy to see.
placeSheet: Create a setting reference illustration for an illustrated folk-tale book: one wide, clear view of the place described below, in soft daylight. No people, animals or trolls. The picture will be used to keep this place the same in every illustration, so show its shape, buildings, landforms and colours clearly.
portrait: Create a portrait of {name} for the character gallery of an illustrated folk-tale book: {name} from the waist up (full body for animals and small creatures), turned slightly towards the viewer with a characteristic expression, in front of a simple, softly painted background from the story world.
cover: Create the cover illustration for an illustrated folk-tale book, in a square format. Do not write a title or any other text on it.
scene: Create one new illustration for an illustrated folk-tale book, showing the moment described below.
rules: No text of any kind: no letters, words, numbers, signatures, captions, speech bubbles or logos.
Every named character must match their model sheet and description exactly: the same face, hair, colours, clothes and proportions.
Suitable for readers of all ages: no blood, wounds or gore, and no killing shown. Show danger and cruelty through atmosphere, posture and suspense, never through injury.
pictureRules: Draw each named character only once.
Show exactly the number of people, animals and things the description asks for, and no extra people.
One clear moment that reads at a glance, as a single full-bleed picture with no border, frame or comic panels.
softenOnModeration: Keep this picture suitable for all ages: show the moment just before or just after any violence, with nobody hurt, no blood and no weapon striking anyone.
